author: Megaprojects
description:
SpaceX is retiring Falcon 9, the most successful rocket ever built, to make way for Starship. This episode explores Falcon 9's revolutionary reusable design, its precise engine control and landing systems, and the economics that transformed space transport. With Starship now reaching orbit, SpaceX is betting everything on bigger ambitions.
